text:
CHOIR

God greets you, oh Mary:

you brought love to the earth

and man in his helplessness

called you "Providence."


Full you are of eternal grace,

precious flower

and loving

that the Eternal One cultivated;

and when to earth you were

sent,

perfumed,

forever it remained.


The Lord is with you:

his clemency

and high essence

he gave you, immortal virgin;

blessed among women,

the most beautiful,

like a star

heavenly light and guide.


And blessed has been the fruit

fortunate

that lovingly

Gabriel announced to the world,

for with his cherished blood

and his cross and

his light

he redeemed us from Lucifer.


If the angels sing to you

melodies,

what joys

they give to your egregious mansion;

angels are we

loved by you,

exiled ones!...

Give us then your blessing.

translation.title: God Greets You, Oh Mary...
translation.editorial_note: The hymn structure and short stepped devotional lines are preserved in English.
